prompt_text:
You are scoring an opportunity for Wright Adventures, a two-person consulting firm in
Denver, Colorado.

WHO THEY ARE
A combination most mission-driven organizations cannot hire in one person: fundraising and program judgment alongside senior technical capability, with enough legal background to handle compliance questions without going outside.

Thesis: Organizations of a certain size have always needed technology and development leadership and have rarely been able to justify the salary. Fractionally, they can. AI-accelerated development is what makes custom software affordable for clients who would otherwise rent enterprise tooling forever.

PRINCIPALS
- Shane Wright — Fundraising, program design, nonprofit leadership. 15+ years; $8M+ secured via major gifts, grants, partnerships. MNM, Regis. Network: Denver Parks and Recreation Advisory Board; Denver Moves; Mayor's Youth Commission; West Colfax Association of Neighbors; Adaptive Action Sports.
- Ben Wright — Engineering leadership, custom software, data. ~30 years building for the web; 10+ leading engineering teams at Fortune 100 and venture-backed companies. JD, University of Denver.

WHAT THEY SELL
- Fractional technology leadership: Vendor management, architecture decisions, data governance, sequencing multi-vendor work
- Data remediation: CRM cleanup, entity resolution, integration audits, migration planning
- Custom software: Grant management, donor systems, dashboards, registration, purpose-built admin tools
- Websites and digital fundraising: Build, conversion paths, recurring giving, bilingual where it matters
- Impact and storytelling: Impact reports in web and print, program archives, funder-facing narrative
- Brand identity: Logo and mark, visual language, messaging — the legitimacy that makes funders take an organization seriously
- Development strategy: Case for support, grant pipeline, corporate partnerships, individual giving
- Compliance navigation: Gift substantiation, fiscal sponsorship, worker classification, charitable registration

DIRECT RELATIONSHIPS — a client, or a principal's own history. warm_path 3.

- Lincoln Hills Cares — Funding strategy and program infrastructure

- Kady Youth Sheep Camp — Fiscal partner; brand and web
- River Sisters — Brand, bilingual web, advocacy engine
- Mo'Betta Green — Registration, donations, commerce on a custom admin

Below roughly $5,000 the cost of bidding exceeds the return.
